message: I tucked these sandbags and tarp away in the garage, trying to outsmart my kids' ability to turn any prep into a game of hide-and-seek. They might not think it’s fun now, but one day, they’ll appreciate the little things that keep us cozy when the weather gets a little too interesting. What’s your secret storm prep trick?
scene: sandbags and a rolled tarp tidy in a garage corner (on a rainy afternoon)
